thread:
devon: Quick sync — planning a small pulse rollout for `dynamic_batching` on low-latency routes today. Start at 2% for 30m, then 5% -> 10% if all guardrails pass. pinging @lucy for metrics windows and @samir for PR review.

lucy: ack. I can watch dashboards. What metrics are we gating on? p95, error_rate, token_cost?

devon: Primary: p95_latency_ms and 5xx_rate. Secondary: tokens_per_sec and cost_per_token. Stop rule: p95 > baseline * 1.07 OR 5xx_rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m. Also fail-open policy to fallback_variant if any infra alerts.

samir: I skimmed the PR -> #7134. Two minor nits on the config parsing, otherwise LGTM. I'll push a tiny fix in a follow-up. Can we include an explicit rollout tag `exp/dynbatch-pulse-2026-03` so experiments service auto-instruments?

devon: yes — will add the tag. Also adding experiment metadata: `owner: eng-platform`, `notify: #eng-platform` and `monitor: lucy`.

anya: small ask: audience slices must be disjoint from other active experiments on these routes. ops has a 1% promo slice this week. Devon can you confirm no overlap?

devon: good catch — confirmed: using slice id `slice:dynb-02` which is non-overlapping with promo slices. I ran the membership check script.

rollout-bot: [automated] created experiment exp/dynbatch-pulse-2026-03 id=E-8421, initial_audience=2%, steps=[2,5,10], autosnapshot=true

qa-jen: I'll run the smoke prompt-set at 2% ramp. Quick checklist: 1) smoke prompts (small set) 2) canary evals (latency + coherency) 3) alert hooks confirmed.

lucy: dashboards linked: https://grafana.redwood/boards/dynbatch-pulse (p50/p95/p99, 5xx, token-rate). I'll create a temporary alert: p95 > baseline * 1.07 (5m), 5xx_rate > 0.5% (3m).

samir: PR fixed and rebased. @devon please run a deploy when ready. I'll be on-call for the first 90m of the rollout.

devon: plan: kick at 14:00 PT. step durations: 30m each with 15m observation before next ramp. If alerts fire, we'll immediately flip the flag off and rollback to fallback_variant. Any objections?

anya: no objections. please @mention infra on any fail-open.

lucy: 👍 I'll post a status update after each step to the thread and add perf snapshots.

devon: thanks all — tagging timelines in the experiment record. Will post final results in #eng-platform-retrospective tomorrow. :rocket:
